blocks.text: 今天，我们发布 Genie 4，这是我们全新的世界模型，它带来了前所未有的真实感，并提升了实时交互式模拟能力。Genie 4 原生支持多模态，能够与世界同步生成类音乐的音频、环境噪声和交互式对话。

inlines.text: 今天，我们发布 Genie 4，这是我们全新的世界模型，它带来了前所未有的真实感，并提升了实时交互式模拟能力。Genie 4 原生支持多模态，能够与世界同步生成类音乐的音频、环境噪声和交互式对话。

blocks.text: Genie 4 模型融合并扩展了 Gemini 系列的能力：Gemini Omni 让模拟在真实世界的外观与行为上有所依托，而其他 Gemini 模型则提供维持模拟连贯性与连续性所需的复杂推理能力。

inlines.text: 在物理与人类动作的真实感上推进前沿

blocks.text: Genie 4 为实时交互式模拟引入了新的真实感标准。基于对世界先进的物理理解，Genie 4 可模拟真实世界的物理场景，例如空气动力学、碰撞等。

blocks.text: 最显著的飞跃在于 Genie 4 如何模拟人，创造出动作自然、对环境做出有机反应、并可在实时中被交互引导的角色。

inlines.text: 建模世界的声响

blocks.text: Genie 4 是我们首个原生生成音频的实时世界模型。每个世界都带有其自身场景的环境声，从林间风声到海滩浪涛。

inlines.text: Genie 4 是我们首个原生生成音频的实时世界模型。每个世界都带有其自身场景的环境声，从林间风声到海滩浪涛。

blocks.text: 然而，真正的前沿是人类语音。Genie 4 引入了可即时调整的交互式对话。角色会交谈，并对你的输入或世界中的事件做出反应，全部实时进行。

inlines.text: 然而，真正的前沿是人类语音。Genie 4 引入了可即时调整的交互式对话。角色会交谈，并对你的输入或世界中的事件做出反应，全部实时进行。

blocks.text: 将 Gemini 与 Genie 4 结合，为世界模拟增添了新的推理层，使我们能够对复杂的多步骤事件建模，并在将 AI 系统带入真实世界之前，测试它们如何在不同的环境中应对。

inlines.text: 将 Gemini 与 Genie 4 结合，为世界模拟增添了新的推理层，使我们能够对复杂的多步骤事件建模，并在将 AI 系统带入真实世界之前，测试它们如何在不同的环境中应对。

blocks.text: 为了实现实时效果，Gemini 3.8 Flash 在循环中充当引导代理：当 Genie 4 实时生成世界时，Gemini 持续观察场景，将目标分解为一系列步骤，并审查传入的帧以跟踪进度并验证每一步是否成功。当世界发生变化或用户介入时，Gemini 会即时调整其计划，从而解锁具有可靠因果性、程序化行为和多步推理的世界。

blocks.text: 来自可信测试者的反馈

inlines.text: 来自可信测试者的反馈

blocks.text: 虽然 Genie 4 是一项重大的研究里程碑，但它仍是一个早期的实验性模型。为了解交互式世界模型如何支持现实世界的工作流程——以及它们仍需在哪些方面成长——我们一直在与来自创意产业、新闻业、教育、游戏和工程领域的多组可信测试者合作。

inlines.text: 虽然 Genie 4 是一项重大的研究里程碑，但它仍是一个早期的实验性模型。为了解交互式世界模型如何支持现实世界的工作流程——以及它们仍需在哪些方面成长——我们一直在与来自创意产业、新闻业、教育、游戏和工程领域的多组可信测试者合作。

blocks.text: 测试者强调了照片级真实感、原生音频和实时操控方面的飞跃如何让想法和概念转化为逼真的模拟，从而解锁跨学科的新能力：

inlines.text: 测试者强调了照片级真实感、原生音频和实时操控方面的飞跃如何让想法和概念转化为逼真的模拟，从而解锁跨学科的新能力：
创意指导
：创意人士和技术专家正在测试将 Genie 4 作为用于预可视化和构思的快速“草稿模式”。例如，电影制作人可以步入场景的实时模拟，并实时进行多次“拍摄”，随时调整摄像机角度、灯光、对话和动作。
历史场景与沉浸式照片
：新闻摄影记者正在探索如何让单张 2D 档案照片在几秒内成为该环境的接地模拟。团队正在测试充满人物、动态的世界如何帮助体验历史空间，或可视化短期环境事件（如突发洪水或野火）如何展开。
交互式体验概念设计
：游戏开发者和创意技术专家正在测试 Genie 4，以在几秒内从初步想法变为可探索的原型，在编写任何一行引擎代码之前，通过自然语言提示测试视觉风格、材质美学和交互机制。
模拟
：除了我们的机器人研究之外，各行业的企业合作伙伴正在评估将 Genie 4 作为快速“从零到一”场景生成的工具，并找出差距，以进一步改进 Genie，从而最好地满足该模拟需求。

blocks.text: 未来工作：迈向混合世界模型

inlines.text: 未来工作：迈向混合世界模型

blocks.text: 未来进展的一条有前景的路径在于混合世界模型，它将代码和语言模型的逻辑、结构化推理与像素级模拟的丰富感官表征相结合。

inlines.text: 未来进展的一条有前景的路径在于混合世界模型，它将代码和语言模型的逻辑、结构化推理与像素级模拟的丰富感官表征相结合。

blocks.text: 将 Genie 和 Gemini 模型更紧密地结合，是这一方向上的早期一步。Gemini 在后台工作，负责映射结构并规划叙事时间线，而 Genie 则生成即时的物理现实——逐像素渲染世界的视觉、声音和响应方式。二者互补的优势相结合，有望解锁一类全新的世界模型，其连贯性、可控性和真实感远超任一单独方法所能达到的水平。

blocks.text: 负责任地构建世界模型

inlines.text: 负责任地构建世界模型

blocks.text: Genie 4 标志着一个新的前沿研究领域，它融合了实时生成与照片级真实感，带来了一系列我们希望以负责任的方式逐步推出和探索的新能力与维度。Genie 4 包含严格的安全护栏，与我们其他模型的安全政策保持一致。在发布此预览版之前，我们通过内部严格的安全评估对 Genie 4 进行了评测，以防止生成有害或恶意内容。此外，我们有意先将其部署给受信任的测试合作伙伴以获取早期反馈，然后再更广泛地发布该模型。

blocks.text: 虽然它能在短时会话中保持连贯的环境，但视觉细节和物体恒存性仍可能随时间发生偏移或漂移——尤其是当模拟运行时间更长、经过多次复杂的提示词编辑后，或在场景中导航时。复杂的物理交互、实时音频准确性、渲染清晰可读的文字、空间准确性以及长期一致性都是正在积极研究的领域。我们以预览形式分享 Genie 4，以便与社区共同学习，并安全地推进交互式模拟的前沿。

blocks.text: Today, we are announcing Genie 4, our new world model, which unlocks unprecedented realism and improves real-time interactive simulation. Genie 4 is natively multimodal, enabling audio-like music, ambient noises, and interactive dialogue to be simultaneously generated with the world.

inlines.text: Today, we are announcing Genie 4, our new world model, which unlocks unprecedented realism and improves real-time interactive simulation. Genie 4 is natively multimodal, enabling audio-like music, ambient noises, and interactive dialogue to be simultaneously generated with the world.

blocks.text: The Genie 4 model incorporates and builds on capabilities from the Gemini family: Gemini Omni anchors the simulations in real-world appearance and behavior, while other Gemini models provide the complex reasoning needed to help maintain a simulation’s coherence and continuity.

inlines.text: The Genie 4 model incorporates and builds on capabilities from the Gemini family: Gemini Omni anchors the simulations in real-world appearance and behavior, while other Gemini models provide the complex reasoning needed to help maintain a simulation’s coherence and continuity.

blocks.text: With this foundation, you can set an event in motion, and Genie 4 simulates what happens next: how the world responds, how it sounds, and how the people in it move, react, and speak.

inlines.text: With this foundation, you can set an event in motion, and Genie 4 simulates what happens next: how the world responds, how it sounds, and how the people in it move, react, and speak.

blocks.text: Understanding and simulating the world is a crucial aspect of building AGI. Genie 4 advances our ability to create safe, infinitely variable simulations that can help with everything from developing training environments for robots and agents to unlocking the creation of new interactive experiences.

blocks.text: Shaping world simulation in real-time

inlines.text: Shaping world simulation in real-time

blocks.text: With Genie 4, you can use natural language to modify a simulation in real-time — like changing the weather, moving the camera, or introducing a new person or object — and Gemini will contextually adapt your prompt to match the surrounding scene. Between your inputs, Gemini also monitors and steers the scene to keep the world progressing cohesively.

blocks.text: Pushing the frontier in realism for physics and human action

inlines.text: Pushing the frontier in realism for physics and human action

blocks.text: Genie 4 introduces a new standard of realism to real-time interactive simulation. Built on an advanced physical understanding of the world, Genie 4 simulates real-world physics scenarios, such as aerodynamics, collisions, and more.

blocks.text: The most dramatic leap is how Genie 4 simulates people, creating characters that move naturally, respond organically to their environments, and can be interactively steered in real-time.

blocks.text: Modeling how the world sounds

inlines.text: Modeling how the world sounds

blocks.text: Genie 4 is our first real-time world model to generate audio natively. Every world carries the ambient sound of its own setting, from wind in the trees to waves crashing at the beach.

blocks.text: The true frontier, however, is human speech. Genie 4 introduces interactive dialogue that adapts on the fly. Characters converse and react to your inputs or events in the world, all in real-time.

blocks.text: Simulating complex events with Gemini models

inlines.text: Simulating complex events with Gemini models

blocks.text: Bringing Gemini and Genie 4 together adds a new layer of reasoning to world simulation, allowing us to model complex, multi-step events and test how AI systems navigate different environments before bringing them to the real world.

inlines.text: Bringing Gemini and Genie 4 together adds a new layer of reasoning to world simulation, allowing us to model complex, multi-step events and test how AI systems navigate different environments before bringing them to the real world.

blocks.text: To achieve this in real-time, Gemini 3.8 Flash serves as a guiding agent in the loop: as Genie 4 generates a world in real-time, Gemini continuously observes the scene, breaks down goals into a sequence of steps, and reviews incoming frames to track the progress and verify that each step succeeded. As the world shifts or the user intervenes, Gemini adapts its plan in the moment, unlocking worlds with reliable causality, procedural behaviors, and multi-step reasoning.

This capability becomes a path for simulating a breadth of scenarios in imagined worlds, using Gemini 4 Argon and Genie 4.

blocks.text: Learnings from trusted testers

inlines.text: Learnings from trusted testers

blocks.text: While Genie 4 is a major research milestone, it remains an early, experimental model. To understand how interactive world models can support real-world workflows—and where they still need to grow—we’ve been working with cohorts of trusted testers across creative industries, journalism, education, gaming, and engineering.

inlines.text: While Genie 4 is a major research milestone, it remains an early, experimental model. To understand how interactive world models can support real-world workflows—and where they still need to grow—we’ve been working with cohorts of trusted testers across creative industries, journalism, education, gaming, and engineering.

blocks.text: Testers highlighted how the leap in photorealism, native audio, and real-time steering allows ideas and concepts to be turned into realistic simulations, unlocking new abilities across disciplines:

inlines.text: Testers highlighted how the leap in photorealism, native audio, and real-time steering allows ideas and concepts to be turned into realistic simulations, unlocking new abilities across disciplines:
Creative direction

: Creatives and technologists are testing Genie 4 as a rapid "draft mode" for pre-visualization and ideation. For example, filmmakers can step into a live simulation of a scene and run multiple "takes" in real-time, adjusting camera angles, lighting, dialogue, and action on the fly.
Historical scenarios & immersive photographs

: Photojournalists are exploring how a single 2D archival photograph can become a grounded simulation of that environment in seconds. Teams are testing how populated, dynamic worlds can help experience historical spaces or visualize how short-term environmental events, like a flash flood or wildfire, unfold.
Interactive experience concept design

: Game developers and creative technologists are testing Genie 4 to go from an initial idea to an explorable prototype in seconds, testing visual styles, material aesthetics, and interactive mechanics through natural language prompts before writing a single line of engine code.
Simulation

: Aside from our robotics research, enterprise partners across industries are evaluating Genie 4 as a tool for rapid "zero-to-one" scenario generation, and identifying gaps to further improve Genie to best fulfill that simulation need.

blocks.text: Future Work: Towards hybrid world models

inlines.text: Future Work: Towards hybrid world models

blocks.text: A promising path for future progress lies in hybrid world models, which combine the logical, structured reasoning of code and language models with the rich, sensory representation of pixel-level simulation.

inlines.text: A promising path for future progress lies in hybrid world models, which combine the logical, structured reasoning of code and language models with the rich, sensory representation of pixel-level simulation.

blocks.text: Bringing Genie and Gemini models closer together is an early step in this direction. Gemini works behind the scenes to map the structure and plan the narrative timeline, while Genie generates the immediate physical reality—rendering how the world looks, sounds, and responds, pixel by pixel. Together, these complementary strengths can unlock a new class of world models that are far more coherent, controllable, and grounded than either approach could achieve alone.

blocks.text: Building world models responsibly

inlines.text: Building world models responsibly

blocks.text: Genie 4 marks a new area of frontier research that merges real-time generation and photorealism, introducing a new range of capabilities and dimensions that we want to roll out and explore in a responsible way. Genie 4 includes strict safety guardrails that are consistent with our safety policies across other models. Before launching this preview, we evaluated Genie 4 through internal rigorous safety evaluations to prevent the generation of harmful or malicious content. Also, we have intentionally deployed it first to trusted tester partners to get early feedback, before we release the model more broadly.

blocks.text: While it can maintain coherent environments over short sessions, visual details and object permanence can still shift or drift over time—especially as a simulation runs longer, after multiple complex prompt edits, or when navigating throughout the scene. Complex physical interactions, real-time audio accuracy, rendering legible text, spatial accuracy, and long-term consistency are active areas of ongoing research. We are sharing Genie 4 as a preview to learn alongside our community and safely advance the frontier of interactive simulation.
